description: EX-CREATE, two creators of one new path. Process a signals and calls DBEngine.CreateDatabase of scratch-race.accdb; process b waits for the signal and calls it at once on the same path (Errors before/after, Version read). Afterwards a reopens the path read-only and lists TableDefs (independent final read). Asks whether the second creator gets 3204 or 3045, whether both succeed, and whether the file opens.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
